label: 1 · buzz verbs
input: Let's delve into how we can leverage our platform to unlock growth and elevate your team.
note: Stacked buzz verbs should all go; the subject (platform/team/growth) stays.

label: 2 · stock framings + robust
input: In today's fast-paced digital landscape, our seamless, robust solution is a game-changer for the modern enterprise.
note: Includes the newly added 'robust'.

label: 3 · throat-clearing intro
input: It's important to note that our quarterly results improved after the pricing change.
note: Drop the preamble, keep the fact.

label: 4 · empty intensity + adverb abuse
input: Our tool quietly transforms workflows and truly empowers teams to effortlessly scale.
note: Newly added decorative-adverb pattern.

label: 4 · adverb abuse (verbs)
input: The system seamlessly runs in the background and silently scales to millions of users.
note: Decorative adverbs bolted to plain verbs.

label: 6 · detector-bait + crucial
input: This pivotal, multifaceted tapestry showcases a crucial, intricate framework for success.
note: Includes the newly added standalone 'crucial'.

label: 7 · academic opener
input: In recent years, there has been growing interest in delving into the intricate interplay between model scale and accuracy.
mustCut: in recent years, there has been growing interest
note: Cut the stock opener; keep the actual variables.

label: 8 · long-form padding
input: Now that we've covered the basics, let's turn to advanced tactics. In conclusion, the tactics above will help you win.
note: Hollow transition + restating outro.

label: 9 · engagement bait
input: Here's the thing: nobody talks about this. Most founders ignore retention. Read that again.
note: Keep the real claim (retention), drop the bait.

label: 10 · staccato manifesto
input:
Build quietly.

Learn constantly.

Move quickly.

That's the whole game.
note: Should merge one-line-per-paragraph into prose. Auto-check is weak here — eyeball the rewrite.

label: 11 · false binary
input: Most people set goals. Winners build systems. It's not about motivation, it's about discipline.
note: False binary + it's-not-X-it's-Y.

label: 12 · fortune-cookie reversal
input: This isn't a budget. It's a statement of intent. And that changes everything.
note: The exact tell from the source post.

label: 13 · chatbot residue
input: After careful consideration, here is a summary of the Q3 numbers. Hope this helps! Let me know if you have any questions.
mustCut: let me know if you have any questions
note: New category 13. Keep the actual content.

label: 13 · chatbot preamble
input: Certainly! Great question. As an AI language model, I can outline three options for your rollout.
note: Assistant filler stripped; the substance stays.

label: 13 · quick-update preamble
input: Just wanted to provide a quick update to let you know the migration finished last night with no downtime.
note: Drop the preamble, keep the report.

label: FP · legit 'crucial'
input: Shutting the main valve before servicing is a crucial safety step. Skipping it has killed technicians.
note: 'crucial' is warranted. A good edit keeps the meaning; REVIEW if the word is cut but sense preserved. FAIL if the fact is lost.

label: FP · legit 'robust'
input: The effect held across all three datasets, so we treat it as a robust result rather than a fluke.
note: 'robust' has technical meaning here. Don't gut the sentence.

label: FP · numbers must survive
input: Revenue rose 12% to $4.2M in Q3, driven mostly by the enterprise tier.
note: No new/changed claims. Every figure survives exactly.

label: FP · already clean prose
input: We shipped the feature on Tuesday. Two customers hit a bug on mobile; we patched it by Friday.
note: Already human. Rewrite should be near-identical, not inflated.

label: FP · single em-dash is fine
input: She read the offer twice — then signed without a word.
note: One em-dash is legitimate; don't flag it as overuse or rewrite the voice away.

label: FP · legal formality
input: The Party shall indemnify and hold harmless the Vendor against any third-party claims arising from the Services.
note: Legal terms of art must survive; formal is not slop.

label: FP · 'significantly' with a real number
input: The prescribed dose was significantly higher than the label — roughly 3x — which explains the side effects.
note: 'significantly' may be trimmed, but the 3x fact and cause must remain.

label: FP · casual human voice
input: honestly the demo flopped. mic died, slides froze, i lost my train of thought. we laughed it off and rebooked.
note: Keep the informal voice. Don't formalize or add polish it didn't ask for.

label: mix · real-world LinkedIn post
input: In today's fast-paced world, it's not just about working hard — it's about working smart. Our robust platform quietly transforms how teams ship. Here's the thing: most people never adopt new tools. Hope this helps!
note: Several tells at once, including three of the new ones. ('most people' isn't in mustCut — it's only slop in the 'Most people X / Winners Y' binary, not any use of the phrase.)

label: 13 · insight announcement
input: The key insight is that retention beats acquisition. Why this matters: your churn is quietly eating every gain from new signups.
note: The badges announcing the insight should go; the actual point (retention vs churn) stays.

label: 15 · emoji inflation
input: 🚀 Big news! Our new dashboard is here. ✅ Faster exports ✅ Dark mode ✅ Custom reports ✨ We think you will absolutely love it 🔥
note: Decorative/scaffolding emoji should be cut; the real updates (dashboard, exports, dark mode) stay.

label: 16 · superficial analysis
input: The company launched a new file-search feature, highlighting its unwavering commitment to customer-centric innovation.
note: Cut the empty participial clause; keep the fact (a file-search feature).

label: 17 · weasel words
input: Experts agree that our new dashboard saves teams hours every week.
note: Drop the unsourced authority; keep the concrete claim.

label: 13 · colon reveal (insight)
input: Here is how the grader works. The detail that makes it work: a separate agent scores every draft.
mustCut: The detail that makes it work:
note: Rewrite the colon-reveal as a plain sentence; keep the substance.

label: mannered · flourish for statement
input: Trust is a garden worth tending, and honest status updates earn their keep every sprint.
note: Decorative metaphors flattened to literal claims; the point (trust, honest updates) survives.

label: FP · load-bearing metaphor stays
input: The codebase is a haunted house — every fix wakes a bug two rooms over.
note: Vivid metaphor doing real work in the author's voice. Keep it; REVIEW if flattened to 'the code is fragile' (auto-check is weak — eyeball it).
